tools.description: Send a message in reply to an event.

oneOf.description: NyxID fetches a public HTTPS URL with its bounded, pinned-address policy.
Standard padded base64, with at most 64 KiB decoded across the request.

native_attachments.description: Explicit native media delivery. Legacy attachment blocks remain links.

thread_reply.description: Request the verified source thread; never fall back when unavailable.

oneOf.description: Approved WhatsApp template; exclusive of text, blocks, media and reply targets.

WhatsappTemplate.description:
The template must already be approved in the destination WhatsApp account.
Approval and placeholder compatibility are checked by Meta on delivery.

WhatsappTemplateComponent.description:
Bounded positional parameters for approved Cloud API templates.
URL buttons substitute a suffix in an already-approved URL, not a new route.

amount_1000.description: Nonnegative amount multiplied by 1000, bounded to exact JSON safe integers.

code.description: Three uppercase ISO 4217 letters; Meta validates the currency itself.

WhatsappTemplateDateTime.description: Explicit date/time label. This CMA contract accepts the fallback string only.

WhatsappTemplateDocument.description: Header document reference, with an optional displayed filename.

code.description: Two- or three-letter language, optionally followed by an uppercase region.

WhatsappTemplateMedia.description: A Meta media ID or HTTPS link, exactly one. Meta verifies media ownership/type.
